## Project Overview
This is a GitHub Action that uses the GitHub Copilot SDK to:
- Read user notifications
- Filter for mentions and important items that need responses
- Send DMs with action items

## Technical Stack
- TypeScript
- GitHub Actions
- @github/copilot-sdk
- Node.js

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Follow GitHub Actions best practices
- Keep action.yml metadata up to date
- Use proper error handling for API calls
